purpose: Two STK, two DUR, and one common R/D/M setting; identical across all five LIBERO suites.
selection_data: Calibration demos 0 and 1 only; no final outcomes used.

objective.coverage: At least 99% execution coverage separately in every suite.
objective.shared: Maximize the smaller of the two mode macro-success rates; then their mean, fewer supports, lower mean MSE.
objective.mode_specific: Maximize sum of four macro-success rates with five distinct finite R/D/M triples and two different M values per mode; then fewer total supports and lower MSE.
